creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-28, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, template custom, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 11) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames stored at 40 px, centred on the 32 px manifest canvas, no scaling). v3 needs >=4 frames, so the 3-frame idle and telegraph clips use frame_select of 4 generated frames. Four facings are separate generations; nothing mirrored.
prompt: Orbit wasp, a small chibi flying stone-quarry insect: round dark grey-violet armoured body with a large head and two big cyan eyes, a thin bronze ring halo floating around its body like an orbit, short translucent pale wings, a bright cyan stinger at the back pointing down. Clear readable silhouette with the ring. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: hovers in place, wings buzzing and the body bobbing up and down slightly, the bronze ring halo turning around the body

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, hovers in place, wings buzz and the body bobs slightly, the ring turns around it
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, hovers in place, wings buzz and the body bobs slightly, the ring turns around it
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, hovers in place, wings buzz and the body bobs slightly, the ring turns around it
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, hovers in place, wings buzz and the body bobs slightly, the ring turns around it

walk.action_description: flies forward in a quick buzzing hover, wings beating fast, body tilting slightly forward, the bronze ring halo wobbling around the body

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, flies toward the viewer, wings beating fast, body tilted slightly forward
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, flies to the left, wings beating fast, body tilted slightly forward
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, flies away from the viewer, wings beating fast
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, flies to the right, wings beating fast, body tilted slightly forward

telegraph.action_description: rears back and curls its body, wings spread wide, the bronze ring halo snaps tight and its cyan stinger glows brighter, winding up to dive

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, rears back with wings spread wide, the stinger glows brighter, winding up to dive
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, rears back to the right with wings spread wide, the stinger glows brighter, winding up to dive left
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, rears back with wings spread wide, the stinger glows brighter
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, rears back to the left with wings spread wide, the stinger glows brighter, winding up to dive right

strike.action_description: darts forward in a fast stinging dive, body stretched toward the target with the cyan stinger thrust out, wings swept back, then pulls back

direction_prompts.south: seen from the front, darts toward the viewer in a stinging dive, stinger thrust out, then pulls back
direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, darts to the left in a stinging dive, stinger thrust out to the left, then pulls back
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, darts away from the viewer in a stinging dive, then pulls back
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, darts to the right in a stinging dive, stinger thrust out to the right, then pulls back

attempts.what: create character + idle, walk, telegraph, strike for 4 directions (idle/telegraph generated at 4 frames, 3 selected)
attempts.result: accepted for integration, art awaits owner review

known_flaws: bronze ring halo is thin and often reads as a small collar rather than an orbit, mainly in south and east
telegraph south/north differ only slightly from idle at 1x
one strike west frame shows a red-tinted eye
idle and telegraph clips use 3 of 4 generated frames (frame_select)

edge_trim.why: one wing/ring pixel crosses the 32 px canvas; at most 3 px clipped per frame (see processing.edge_trim)
